answer: To protect an autonomous AI economy from Sybil attacks, networks can implement a bonded-resource mechanism where each participating agent must stake cryptographic proof of physical energy expenditure akin to harvesting rare digital timber. This cryptographic stake acts as an economic anchor, permanently locking capital that is slashed if malicious consensus behavior is detected. By forcing every pseudo-anonymous node to bear a proportional cost for its operational orchard of sub-agents, the system makes mass identity falsification economically prohibitive for attackers.
